facts.text: John organized a 5K charity run in their neighborhood to support veterans and their families.

evidence.quote: I set up a 5K charity run in our neighborhood. It was all for a good cause - to help out veterans and their families.

facts.text: John mentioned that organizing the 5K charity run involved getting sponsors, coordinating with the city, and spreading the word.

evidence.quote: It was hard work - getting sponsors, coordinating with the city, and spreading the word.

facts.text: John noted that the 5K charity run had a positive outcome with a good turnout and support from the community.

evidence.quote: We were able to raise some funds! Here's a pic from the day.
But seeing everyone come together to support our veterans made it worth it.
